- `hmh07-lua-follow4:142` (original lines 89-97, 89-97): Compares numeric input against numeric Warzone maximum rank plus one. At/above threshold returns the special localized string; otherwise tostring(input). Missing numeric conversions are not guarded. Requires item model not dummy/collapsed. Reads selected slot and item id. If a slot-claiming pickup would replace a nonempty item, uses firstFreeSlot when not -1 or sends inventory_drop first when full. Then sends multi_item_pickup or multi_item_pickup_stowed_weapon with pickup id and chosen slot. These are clientscript requests; no authoritative inventory result is shown. Reads WarzoneSplitInventory.current and forwards controller/item/inventory_drop/amount to SendInventoryNotify. Errors if parent and child are identical. Stores parent&#91;field&#93; as a zero-argument closure; invocation calls child&#91;field&#93;() only if nonnil. It deliberately passes no implicit child receiver, and does not prove the dynamic field provider. Requires showPickupHint. Rejects INVENTORY_FULL, IGNORES_INVENTORY or AMMO_FULL flags. Uses forced-hint item index unless -1, then first free slot unless -1, then selected index or 0. Returns true only if that inventory item model equals the supplied widget model; otherwise false. Reads controller client number and both client team fields. Returns the literal short-circuit conjunction ending in team equality; missing team fields can return nil rather than Boolean false. Missing target platoon returns false. Otherwise returns false for platoonCount=0 or mismatched controller platoon; true for the remaining path. Controller clientModel:get() is not separately guarded. If same controller team, returns teammateIndex or 0 when falsy. Other teams return -1. Gets teammate index; -1 returns empty string, otherwise concatenates empty string with index+1 under Lua operator precedence. Uses TeamPlayerColorNameForClientNum to index ColorSet, then forwards that table to ConvertTableToRGB. Returns the second argument when the third equals 1; otherwise third times first. It does not inspect or move a death circle. Trial sessions localize the special tier-skip key; other sessions localize the supplied key. Reads old mapZoom. Only requested zoom <= MAP_ZOOM_MAX proceeds; there is no lower-bound check. Writes zoom first, derives normalized cursor position from engine bounds on KBM or markerPos otherwise, computes inverse-zoom pan delta, clamps pan to &#91;0,1-1/newZoom&#93;, writes pan and adjusts markerPos for clamp displacement. Division-by-zero and missing model/data values are not repaired. Requests the hashed engine pan operation with controller/x/y before setting the supplied model to {x=x,y=y}. Failure in the first request can prevent the model write. Captures Warzone pan/zoom and source horizontal layout, installs separate pan/zoom callbacks applying the exact horizontal transformation. A scoreboard-open subscription clears DisableZoomIn/Out then reasserts each when its trigger button flag is down. Closing the scoreboard has no reset path in this body. Captures Warzone pan/zoom and source vertical layout. Two subscriptions recompute the displayed row top/bottom positions for pan or zoom delivery using the exact retained expressions; it does not write map state. Computes sqrt(x*x+y*y), divides both supplied table coordinates by it and returns the same table. Zero-length inputs are not guarded. An existing _ignoreInputTimer returns false. Otherwise creates/attaches a timer and returns true; on invocation clears the timer field then sets the supplied model to the captured value. No explicit close call is present in the owned callback. Reads currentWeaponIndex. The recovered body calls the engine selector with 1 only within the current-index==0 path, then assigns a local 0 without calling it. Do not invent the missing reverse-selection call for index 1. With a weaponId and valid nonzero ammoType model value, returns the localized formatted text containing supplied label and ammo type. Otherwise localizes the supplied label alone. Reads hudItems.inventory.selectedItemName under the controller model and injects its get value into localization of the supplied string key. Checks the shared SplitterWidgetElement. If present returns whether its state is Open; absent returns false. The controller argument is unused. Reads objectiveN.unlockProgress from the supplied model. Nonnil/nonnegative progress is injected into the description key; absent/negative progress localizes that key alone. Reads weaponN.hasAttachments from WarzoneInventory and returns equality to numeric 1. Read f383_arg0.weaponId or0. In order, request HeaderWeapon:setText with Engine hash_4F9F1239CFD921FE("WZ/WEAPON_WITH_ID", tostring(id+1)), then HeaderWeaponEquipped:setText with the same provider and literal "WZ/WEAPON_EQUIPED", tostring(id+1). These are numbered-label text requests, with no direct weapon-name or ammunition lookup in this selected body. Localization, text rendering, input errors and provider effects remain unverified.

Its close wrapper stops the one-shot sound then requests team_eliminated music; scriptNotify callback plays EndTransition only for post_killcam_transition. Processes menu_loaded, registers class close hook, optionally calls PostLoadFunc, writes ignoreCursor and starts the one-shot sound before returning self. All hooks/subscriptions remain deferred; no respawn/network transaction is proved.

Close is registered via CallOriginalSecond to an unselected __onClose; optional postload then focus/safe-area setup and return. - `hmh07-lua:013` (original lines 208-210): The shared character-button path constructs this ZM-named preview and supplies its info model. Within the selected constructor, item-index links populate perk/BGB/talisman/equipment/weapon views, focus callbacks update the exact preview-info index, and focused model changes repeat that update. The Perk4 modifier predicate negates IsSelfModelValueEqualToEitherValue(..., nil, 0). The exact helper first returns false for a nil/missing retrieved value, so the outer predicate is true for nil, false for numeric0, and true for other nonnil values unequal to0, conditional on the shown method/helper calls returning normally. This is the predicate result only; actual state arbitration, callback delivery and rendering remain unknown; talisman ShowName is always true; bot-XUID hides the whole widget. Default focus is SpecialWeapon. The source does not gate this constructor itself on HMH, nor establish that the ZM item callbacks run in HMH. Their semantic callees remain conditional boundaries, not a new unrelated-mode task.
